framework: Common Core State Standards for Mathematics
important_note: Common Core is used as the US baseline comparison framework. It is not a national curriculum and does not represent every US state.

place_value.summary: Develop whole-number relationships and place value through tens and ones, including numbers to at least 100.

multiplication_division.summary: No formal multiplication/division content domain yet; Grade 1 focuses on addition/subtraction structures that prepare multiplicative thinking.

fractions.summary: Partition circles and rectangles into halves and fourths and reason about equal shares; this is a geometry foundation rather than a formal fractions domain.

place_value.summary: Extend base-ten notation to 1,000, including hundreds, tens and ones; compare and operate using place-value reasoning.

multiplication_division.summary: Work with equal groups to build foundations for multiplication, including odd/even structure and rectangular arrays.

fractions.summary: Continue equal-share reasoning through geometry; formal Number and Operations—Fractions begins in Grade 3.

place_value.summary: Use place value to round whole numbers and to perform arithmetic within 1,000; multiply one-digit numbers by multiples of 10 using place-value reasoning.

multiplication_division.summary: Interpret products and quotients through equal groups, arrays and measurement; use properties and inverse relationships; achieve fluency within 100.

fractions.summary: Develop fractions as numbers, including unit fractions, number-line representations, equivalence and comparison.

place_value.summary: Generalise multi-digit whole-number place value, including the ten-times relationship between adjacent places, reading/writing/comparing, and rounding.

multiplication_division.summary: Use place value and properties to multiply up to four-digit by one-digit and two-digit by two-digit numbers, and to divide with remainders; explain using equations, arrays and area models.

fractions.summary: Explain and generate equivalent fractions using visual models, compare fractions with different numerators/denominators, build fractions from unit fractions, and multiply a fraction by a whole number.

place_value.summary: Extend place-value reasoning to decimals through thousandths and powers of 10; use place value to support operations with decimals.

multiplication_division.summary: Achieve fluency with multi-digit whole-number multiplication, divide up to four-digit dividends by two-digit divisors using place-value/property reasoning, and operate with decimals to hundredths.

fractions.summary: Use equivalent fractions to add/subtract unlike denominators, interpret fractions as division, multiply fractions, and divide unit fractions by whole numbers or whole numbers by unit fractions.

place_value.summary: Place value is no longer a standalone NBT domain; students extend prior number understanding to rational numbers, including negative numbers and coordinates.

multiplication_division.summary: Compute fluently with multi-digit numbers and decimals, find common factors/multiples, and extend division to fractions divided by fractions.

fractions.summary: Interpret and compute quotients of fractions, including fraction-by-fraction division, while applying visual models and equations to problem contexts.

source_locator: Common Core State Standards for Mathematics, Grades 1-6 content standards and grade introductions.
